intent: Gradually raise the internet slice data rate from 20 Mbps to 60 Mbps. Do not apply the full change at once — break it into at least 3 smaller increases, checking feasibility_checker before each one. After each increase, query ambr_dl_mean via kpi_analyzer to confirm it landed. Only proceed to the next increase after KPI confirmation. Use policy_manager with sub_action apply. AMBR in bps. The target_slice parameter is 'internet'.
